column1: # mode:  copy   = add/update only, never deletes on dest      (safest)
#        sync   = make dest mirror source, DELETES extras      (kept in .cloudsync-backups/)
#        bisync = two-way; run `cloudsync resync <name>` once before first `run`
# paths: iCloudDocs/<sub> = iCloud Drive files | iCloudAll/<sub> = all iCloud app containers | Remote:path = rclone remote
# extra: any rclone flags, e.g. --filter-from <file>, --exclude '*.tmp', or @prefetch (materialize iCloud stubs)
# IMPORTANT: columns are separated by a single TAB, not spaces. `cloudsync edit` opens this file.
